_law: Operator mandate 2026-09-17 (REPO-WIDE NO-FALLBACK MECHANICAL LOCK): a semantic field may contain only the exact value defined by that field. If its canonical source is missing, stale, malformed, partial, unauthorized, rejected, delayed, or failed, the field must expose that exact failure state or fail closed. No other value may replace it. This file names the scoped, evidenced exceptions the mission itself allows ("an independently useful alternative may exist only as a separately named semantic") -- it is NOT a per-line fallback allowlist (the mission explicitly forbids that); every entry here authorizes a NAMED FILE or METHODOLOGY, requires an operator_quote to add or widen, and is enforced by tools/check_no_fallback_lock.py against the STAGED DIFF, mirroring governance/level_faucets.json's existing 'operator_quote co-staged' convention (RC-212).
_how_to_widen: Adding a file to ml_imputation_authorized_files, or otherwise widening this registry, requires this file's own diff to be co-staged with an operator_quote key on the SAME added entry. tools/check_no_fallback_lock.py rejects a widening diff with no operator_quote.

_verdicts.REJECT: a staged diff adds a banned syntactic shape (SQL COALESCE/IFNULL/NVL on a non-aggregate, non-display-label default; pandas imputation outside an authorized file; an except handler substituting an empty collection or literal zero for a semantic-field target; a JS ||/?? substitution on a registered protected field; deletion/weakening of this registry or the lock's own detector without an operator_quote)
_verdicts.PASS: the staged diff adds none of the above, or the shape is a confirmed-safe idiom (aggregate-over-empty-set, a self-describing display-label default, an UPDATE-preserve-existing COALESCE, or explicit failure-state disclosure)
